# Session-log self-check

Date: 2026-11-15; seed base: 16112026; mode: full.
Command: `.venv/bin/python -m bench.selfcheck_logs --date 2026-11-15`

All simulated rates include counts and Wilson 95% intervals. Claude Code's three measures are generated through Response/EditResult -> measures.build -> decide_tool. Reasoning: log-normal, quantized to multiples of 100 before exact changes. Independent shares: rounded (0.10+0.25 Phi(Z)) and (0.05+0.25 Phi(Z)), denominator 100. Shared ranks: both shares 10/(20+pooled reasoning rank), oriented alike. AR(1): stationary Gaussian innovations on all three independent latent streams. Pilot-based count reductions use timing only, never measured outcomes; requested and actual counts are printed. Simulation gates are implementation checks, not proofs.
Exact enumeration: PASS; n+m <= 14; 98301 rank labelings; distinct, three-level and equal ties; every runs (a,b) and every U threshold.

## Assumption counterexamples (demonstrations, not valid product claims)

Demonstration outside A2: 15 days / 3,003 models; after-count selection rejects in 3003/3003 labelings, p_real=1/3003 every time. Product pooled counts are all 305 and select model-1 for every checked split.
Demonstration outside A4: 98 days, 49 low/49 high, exact 25% token move and swapped 19/20-response usability; exact NO DROP probability 4644850223/5013649282 = 0.926441 (hypergeometric enumeration, not simulation).
